label: Probability practice questions, Deep Institute IIT JAM assignment

items.stem: A second order determinant is written down at random using the numbers 1 and −1, as elements. The probability that the value of the determinant is non-zero, is
items.explanation: Enumerate the 16 sign matrices. The determinant is zero in 8 and nonzero in 8, so the probability is 1/2, option A.
